text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black's running lacked its usual 
sharpness and tenacity. Her 
uncharacteristic performance leaves the 
spectators in an uproar.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black must have been carrying 
lingering fatigue from the fierce battle 
in the Tenno Sho (Spring). Pushing herself 
too hard without rest had thrown her out 
of top form.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black breaks down in tears, 
feeling she let down everyone's 
expectations. Satono Diamond gently 
consoles her, telling her not to worry.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The fans see themselves in Kitasan Black's 
hard work and cheer her on. That's why 
they surely expect her to get back on her 
feet without giving up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And that she had high expectations too. 
Leaving those words behind, Satono Diamond 
entrusted the answer to Kitasan Black.
